findings.title: Smoke succeeds when readiness DOWN or unauthenticated API returns200
preconditions: Real candidate smoke shell; Docker/wget transport replaced by QA-only recorded fixture.
reproduction_steps: Run qa/independent/deployment_edges.py at the exact SHA.
findings.expected: Every failed smoke assertion returns nonzero and blocks release.
findings.actual: Both negative scenarios exit0; valid control also exits0.
findings.cause: Intermediate && echo lists are exempt from errexit; only final condition determines status.
findings.risk: Can certify an unhealthy or authorization-regressed deployment. No actual current API bypass claimed.
